If seq[0] is a String, subSeq may be a String (subSequence of CharSequence returns CharSequence - for String returns String). Should work.

- Exception handling: translate may throw IOException from Writer; test that when writer throws IOException, translate propagates.

- Test that when lookup contains duplicate keys, later overrides? currently map.put will overwrite earlier.

- Test with empty lookup array.
